verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a broad REST API (issue management, releases, alerts, webhooks) and an MCP server/CLI for AI-agent access, showing substantial API coverage, but there's no explicit claim or evidence of full UI/API parity, and probes for a discoverable OpenAPI spec all 404'd, suggesting gaps in comprehensive API documentation. missing for 10: explicit full UI/API parity statement, discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, evidence covering less common UI features (dashboards, ownership rules, org settings) via API.
